final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS pid, p.death_country AS dc, COUNT(*) AS c FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), s2 AS (SELECT dc, SUM(c) AS t FROM s1 GROUP BY dc) SELECT s1.pid, s1.dc, s1.c, (s1.c * 1.0) / NULLIF(s2.t, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.dc = s2.dc ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
